name: cra-app
description: Fixture: Create React App (react-scripts 5.0.1, deprecated Feb 2025). Scaffolded successfully at React 19.2.8 - the 'scaffolder fails against 19' reports did not reproduce here. Must run with DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true: react-scripts' bundled eslint-webpack-plugin otherwise resolves the much newer ESLint hoisted from packages/reactive-axi's own devDependency in this pnpm workspace and fails to compile at all - a real pnpm-workspace toolchain collision, not a React-version issue. The dev-server-manager CRA adapter (Phase 2) must set this env var when spawning react-scripts.
